risk_note: Guard change (tools/**, RV2 by path). CT-06zzzzzv (D10-2152 / D10-2163): red-check and evidence-check compare a top-level for…of over an inline array literal (same row count and order, loop body token for token the same, one it per row) row by row. A row whose source text equals the base row at the same index is an unchanged test (red_exempt applies), literal or not; a changed row must be wholly literal, exist at the same base index and differ, and is declared in modify_existing by its full name after the change (its title follows the row data); the evidence records the row text before and after. Anything else — a table by name, imported or from a call, a spread, a changed loop body, added / removed / moved rows, a changed row with a non-literal, a duplicate name, for…in, not top level — falls back to the whole-file judgement. tools/ci/evidence-check.ts itself unchanged (compareModifiedBlocks carries the row).
